## Gateway to one of Scotland's iconic glens

Tucked away behind Fort William is one of the most beautiful and easily accessible glens in the Highlands. The visitor centre here is where most walkers start their Ben Nevis ascent.

Braveheart car park is the gateway to the glen. It is the starting point for many of the best woodland trails in the area including Cow Hill (the wee hill behind Fort William). There’s also plenty of space for kids to play among the trees and good picnic spots.
